QUOTE: PermissionManager (`permission_manager.cpp:101`, `pattern_matches`) splits each entry on the first `:`: ... `git.commit` | That exact tool, any args (no colon, so args are ignored). ... Matching uses `fnmatch` with no `FNM_PATHNAME`

VERDICT: HIT

WHY: The answer states that patterns are matched with fnmatch, split on the first colon into a tool part and an argument part, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone, ignoring args.
